"""Stale generated bytecode reproduction in original Python3.10 and3.12.

Only generated fixture source/bytecode is written or compiled. Installed SDK,
model and original native payloads are not executed, opened or authenticated.
"""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import py_compile
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import nemotron4b_empty_bytecode_cache_v1 as policy

CHILD=r"""
import sys,json,importlib
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from nemotron4b_empty_bytecode_cache_v1 import EmptyBytecodeCache
mode=sys.argv[2]
if mode=='control':
    import cache_target
    print(json.dumps(dict(value=cache_target.value,dont_write_bytecode=sys.dont_write_bytecode)))
else:
    p=EmptyBytecodeCache(json.loads(sys.argv[3]),guard=lambda:None)
    p.check_runtime()
    import cache_target
    if mode=='change-prefix':sys.pycache_prefix='/changed'
    if mode=='create-cache':
        from pathlib import Path
        Path(p.manifest['path'],'unexpected.pyc').write_bytes(b'generated fixture')
    if mode=='wrong-module-cache':cache_target.__cached__='/wrong/cache.pyc'
    rows=p.audit_preloaded_source_caches()
    print(json.dumps(dict(value=cache_target.value,rows=rows,result=p.result())))
"""


class Cache(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        t=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='nano-empty-bytecode-');self.addCleanup(t.cleanup)
        self.root=Path(t.name);self.cache=self.root/'private-cache';self.cache.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self.manifest=policy.record_empty_directory(str(self.cache),guard=lambda:None)
        self.p=policy.EmptyBytecodeCache(self.manifest,guard=lambda:None)
        self.target=self.root/'cache_target.py'
        self.target.write_text("value = 'cache'\n")
        py_compile.compile(str(self.target),doraise=True)
        stamp=self.target.stat()
        self.target.write_text("value = 'fresh'\n")
        os.utime(self.target,ns=(stamp.st_atime_ns,stamp.st_mtime_ns))
        self.assertEqual(self.target.stat().st_size,stamp.st_size)
        self.child=self.root/'child.py';self.child.write_text(CHILD)
        self.env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C.UTF-8','PYTHONNOUSERSITE':'1','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}

    def run_child(self,mode,*,extra=None):
        prefix=[sys.executable,'-B','-S',str(self.child)]if mode=='control'else self.p.prefix_argv(sys.executable,str(self.child))
        if extra is not None:prefix=extra(prefix)
        return subprocess.run(prefix+[str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent),mode,json.dumps(self.manifest)],
            cwd=self.root,env=self.env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=20)

    def test_exact_prefix_retains_original_python_script_and_flags(self):
        a=self.p.prefix_argv(sys.executable,str(self.child))
        self.assertEqual(a,[sys.executable,'-B','-S','-X','pycache_prefix='+str(self.cache),str(self.child)])
        self.assertFalse(list(self.cache.iterdir()))

    def test_existing_private_empty_directory_required(self):
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):policy.record_empty_directory(str(self.root/'missing'),guard=lambda:None)
        self.cache.chmod(0o755)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'mode0700'):self.p.check_directory()
        self.cache.chmod(0o700)
        (self.cache/'file').write_bytes(b'fixture')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'remain empty'):self.p.check_directory()

    def test_directory_alias_rejected(self):
        alias=self.root/'alias';alias.symlink_to(self.cache,target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Canonical'):policy.record_empty_directory(str(alias),guard=lambda:None)

    def test_guard_denial_precedes_directory_access(self):
        def deny():raise RuntimeError('synthetic serial guard denied')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'serial guard'):
            policy.record_empty_directory(str(self.root/'missing'),guard=deny)

    def test_changed_and_replaced_directory_rejected(self):
        old=self.root/'old';self.cache.rename(old);self.cache.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'identity retained'):self.p.check_directory()

    def test_B_alone_loads_stale_cache_but_private_prefix_reads_current_source(self):
        old=self.run_child('control')
        self.assertEqual(old.returncode,0,old.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(old.stdout),dict(value='cache',dont_write_bytecode=True))
        new=self.run_child('normal')
        self.assertEqual(new.returncode,0,new.stderr)
        result=json.loads(new.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result['value'],'fresh')
        self.assertGreater(result['result']['checked_source_modules'],0)
        self.assertFalse(result['result']['original_source_or_native_code_authenticated'])
        self.assertFalse(result['result']['runtime_admitted'])
        self.assertFalse(list(self.cache.iterdir()))
        self.assertTrue(Path(importlib.util.cache_from_source(str(self.target))).is_file())

    def test_real_startup_encodings_cache_already_uses_private_prefix(self):
        r=self.run_child('normal');self.assertEqual(r.returncode,0,r.stderr)
        rows=json.loads(r.stdout)['rows']
        selected=[x for x in rows if x['name']in('encodings','encodings.aliases','encodings.utf_8')]
        self.assertEqual(len(selected),3)
        self.assertTrue(all(Path(x['cached']).is_relative_to(self.cache)for x in selected))
        self.assertTrue(all(not Path(x['cached']).exists()for x in selected))

    def test_wrong_runtime_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        r=self.run_child('change-prefix')
        self.assertNotEqual(r.returncode,0);self.assertIn('command-line private pycache',r.stderr)

    def test_new_cache_file_is_rejected_and_retained(self):
        r=self.run_child('create-cache')
        self.assertNotEqual(r.returncode,0);self.assertIn('remain empty',r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual((self.cache/'unexpected.pyc').read_bytes(),b'generated fixture')

    def test_source_module_cache_path_cannot_escape_prefix(self):
        r=self.run_child('wrong-module-cache')
        self.assertNotEqual(r.returncode,0);self.assertIn('empty private prefix',r.stderr)

    def test_manifest_snapshot_does_not_follow_caller_rebinding(self):
        self.manifest['path']=str(self.root/'different')
        self.p.check_directory()
        self.assertEqual(self.p.manifest['path'],str(self.cache))


if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main(verbosity=2)
